description: Defines the TimeUntilDisconnectNotification class, representing device readiness and disconnect timing information, including methods to create instances from messages and calculate expiry.

classes.name: TimeUntilDisconnectNotification
classes.description: Encapsulates device disconnect readiness info, including creation from messages and expiry calculation.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Creates an Optional<TimeUntilDisconnectNotification> from an AMQP message, extracting relevant properties.

methods.name: getReadyUntilInstantFromTtd
methods.description: Calculates the Instant until which the device remains connected based on TTD.

methods.name: getMillisecondsUntilExpiry
methods.description: Returns milliseconds until the notification expires, considering max expiry for unlimited TTD.
